title: Version stamping
description:
Turn a version and build number into the strings and numbers a version resource needs.

```
version 2.5.1, build 347
FILEVERSION 2,5,1,347
"FileVersion" "2.5.1.347"
packed: MS 0x00020005, LS 0x0001015B
```
hints: Generate a header with these values from your build script so the version lives in one place.
requirements: Four parts from 0 to 65535; refuse anything else.
Produce the `FILEVERSION` line and the string value for a `.rc` file.
Pack into the two 32-bit numbers `VS_FIXEDFILEINFO` stores.
stretch: Compare two packed versions to decide which is newer.
